title: Cooling demand
brief: Program the cooling fan so it can be started manually or automatically when cooling is needed.
requirements: Manual Demand is ON when the operator requests the fan. Temperature OK is ON when the temperature is normal and OFF when the temperature is too high.
Turn the cooling fan ON whenever Manual Demand is ON, regardless of the temperature.
Also turn the fan ON whenever Temperature OK is OFF, even if Manual Demand is OFF.
The fan must only be OFF when Manual Demand is OFF and Temperature OK is ON. It must respond immediately to changes in either input.
hints: A normally closed (negated) contact passes logic when its operand is 0.
Use two parallel paths: one tests manual demand; the other tests NOT Temperature OK.
